title: My account
description: Your details, wallet balance, and transaction history in one place.

profile.title: Account details
profile.description: The name shown in the store and on support messages.
profile.emailHint: Contact support to change your email.

password.title: Password
password.description: Choose a strong password you do not use anywhere else.
password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

wallet.title: My wallet
wallet.description: Your balance and every movement on it.
wallet.rechargeSoon: Payment methods are coming soon. Contact support to add balance for now.
wallet.historyDescription: This history is append-only and cannot be edited.
wallet.emptyDescription: Every top-up, purchase, and refund appears here.

orders.title: My orders
orders.description: Every order with its status and delivery details.
orders.emptyDescription: Start from the games catalog and pick your first package.
orders.soonDescription: The cart and wallet payment arrive in the next stage.

telegram.title: Telegram bot
telegram.linkedDescription: This chat is linked to your account. Use the bot to see your orders and balance — no need to sign in again.
telegram.unlinkedDescription: Link the bot to your account so you can see your orders and balance from Telegram.
telegram.codeHint: Send this code to the store bot in Telegram:

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Everything about your orders and top-ups, in one place.
notifications.emptyDescription: We will tell you here when an order is delivered or your wallet is topped up.

support.title: Get help
support.description: Ask us about an order, a top-up, or anything else. Replies arrive here and in your notifications.
support.noThreads: You have not asked us anything yet.
support.unavailable: Your requests could not be loaded. Nothing has been lost — try again in a moment.
support.newDescription: Tell us what happened and we will come back to you.
support.bodyHint: Include the order number if it is about an order.
support.closedNotice: This request is closed. Send a new one if you still need help.
support.missingDescription: This request does not exist, or it is not yours.

errors.invalid_input: Please fill in both the subject and the message.
errors.too_many: You already have several open requests. We will answer those first.
errors.closed: This request is closed, so it cannot take a reply.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Nothing was sent — please try again.

banned.title: Account suspended
banned.description: This account has been suspended. Contact support to find out why and to restore it.

recovery.requestDescription: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link.
recovery.requestSent: If that email is registered, a message with a reset link is on its way.
recovery.resetDescription: Choose a new password for your account.
recovery.resetDone: Your password is set. You can use it now.
recovery.linkExpired: That link has expired or is not valid. Request a new one.

errors.invalid_input: Check the values you entered, then try again.
errors.username_taken: That username is taken. Pick another.
errors.weak_password: That password is too short. Use at least 8 characters.
errors.not_signed_in: Your session expired. Sign in and try again.
errors.unknown: We could not complete that. Please try again.
